mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the risk-free rate environment supports higher valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.25pp monthly increase in federal funds rate signals aggressive tightening, immediately pressuring equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment decline >0.1pp and payroll growth >500 in one month signal labor market strength that accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.1pp and PAYEMS rises > 500 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls >0.1pp and PAYEMS rises >500 in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A high-demand regime defined by HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 540000 signals robust housing and consumer spending, accelerating corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 540000, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.5 for two consecutive months indicates sustained manufacturing strength, supporting corporate profit growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.5, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending (RSAFS) below 540000 million dollars signals weakening demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate earnings growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 540000, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing construction decline >100 units and consumer spending drop >10000 in one month signal demand contraction, depressing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 100 units and RSAFS falls > 10000 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls >100 and RSAFS falls >10000 in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) increases economic uncertainty and reduces corporate investment, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.
